assets_note: No videos/2026-11-17_scrapling/assets/ folder exists, so every window is a DRAWN mockup (window-mockup-slide-up, paper version: white card #FFFFFF, 1 px #DCD6CA, 24 px radius, shadow 0 18 40 rgba(20,20,24,.16), 48 px chrome bar with three 10 px #DCD6CA dots, chrome label JetBrains Mono Medium 22 px #6E6A64, ink text, flame accent, cobalt second emphasis).

shared_motion.drift: every window hold drifts continuously: translateY 0 -> -8 px and scale 1.00 -> 1.02, sine in-out over the hold, never stopping; restart from the current value after each swap (no jump)
shared_motion.swap: window replaces window by sliding: old slides out left (x -> -1080, 300 ms cubic in), new slides in from the right (x +1080 -> rest, 300 ms cubic out), overlapping; no hard cut inside a stretch
shared_motion.pointer: drawn macOS-style arrow pointer, 36 px, ink #141418 fill with 2 px #FFFFFF edge and a soft shadow; travels 60-120 px (cubic, 300 ms) to each target, arriving 200 ms before the beat's word, and parks 16 px right/below the target, never on top of it; idles with a 2 px sway between beats
shared_motion.pop: chips/pills pop scale 0.8 -> 1 + fade 170 ms; typed text appears word by word on each word's onset (typing follows speech), not on a clock
shared_motion.never: no text on screen before its spoken word; no change on a word not in the beats list (drift and pointer travel excepted)
